title: PLTR-APD: which component owns it, in the inspection app

layers.name: Ontology model
items: Pump keyed on the asset number
Inspection as its own object type

layers.name: Actions
items: Every write goes through an Action
Submission criteria checked at run time

layers.name: Workshop or OSDK
items: Scopes list exactly what the app uses

layers.name: Automate
items: Event trigger creates the follow-up task
At least once, so idempotent effects

layers.name: AI, security, operations
items: AIP Logic classifies notes into fault types

caption: Build from the top band down: each band relies on the ones above it, and a wrong option usually puts the work in the wrong band.
alt: Six layers of the inspection app: Ontology model, Actions, Functions, Workshop or OSDK, Automate, AI with security and operations.
